ChatAssistant.title: AI Assistant
ChatAssistant.greeting: Hi! I can add a new column to one of your tables, add a whole new table, or create a saved view of a table. Try something like "add a warranty date to Jobs", "add a table for employee timesheets", or "show me unpaid invoices sorted by date".
ChatAssistant.placeholder: Describe the column, table, or view to add…
ChatAssistant.successTableAdded: Done. I created {table}. You'll find it in your table switcher at the top of the dashboard.
ChatAssistant.successViewAdded: Done. I created the {view} view. You'll find it in your table switcher at the top of the dashboard.
ChatAssistant.successValueAdded: Done. I added {value} as a choice for {field}.
ChatAssistant.successValueRenamed: Done. I renamed that choice to {value} for {field}. Your existing records are unchanged.
ChatAssistant.successValueArchived: Done. I removed {value} from the choices for {field}. Records that already use it still show it, and it's no longer offered for new entries.
ChatAssistant.viewRemoved: Done. I removed the {view} view. Your table and all its records are untouched.
ChatAssistant.viewUndone: Removed the {view} view again. Your records are safe.
ChatAssistant.tableHideOffer: To keep your records safe, I don't delete whole tables. I can hide the {table} table instead, so it drops off your dashboard while every record stays saved. You can bring it back anytime from Settings. Want me to hide it?
ChatAssistant.tableKept: No problem. I've left the {table} table just as it was.
ChatAssistant.tableHidden: Done. I've hidden the {table} table, so it's off your dashboard. All of its records are still saved, and you can bring it back anytime from Settings.
ChatAssistant.tableRestored: Done. The {table} table is back on your dashboard, with all of its records.
ChatAssistant.tableUndone: Done. I've hidden the {table} table again. All of its records are still saved.
ChatAssistant.tableHideLast: I'd rather not hide that one, since it's your only table and your dashboard would be empty. If you add another table first, I can hide this one afterward.
ChatAssistant.tableHideFailed: I couldn't hide that table just now. Please try again in a moment.
ChatAssistant.columnHidden: To keep your data safe, I don't delete columns. I've hidden {field} from {table} instead, so it no longer shows up. Your information is still saved and you can bring it back anytime.
ChatAssistant.restored: Done. That column is visible again, and your data was never touched.
ChatAssistant.undone: Undone. That column is hidden again, and your data is safe.
ChatAssistant.undoFailed: I couldn't undo that just now. Please try again in a moment.
ChatAssistant.rejection: That change isn't allowed. Try describing what you'd like to add instead.
ChatAssistant.declineFallback: Right now I can add a new column, a new table, or a saved view. I can help with that whenever you like.
ChatAssistant.clarifyFallback: Which table should this column go on?
ChatAssistant.degraded: I couldn't reach the assistant just now. Your tables and records are all still working. Please try again in a moment.
ChatAssistant.forbidden: You don't have permission to use the assistant.
